systems.system: Civil Registration and Vital Statistics System (CRVSS)
systems.owner: Civil Registration Services, Ministry of Interior and Coordination of National Government
systems.tiers: some local civil registration offices; piloted in a number of counties, rollout under way, with sub-counties still sending records to headquarters on CDs and flash discs

systems.platform: integrated technology platform linked to the Integrated Population Registration System
systems.tiers: one-stop citizen service centres operating in most of the counties

note: Civil registration in Kenya is run by a national service through its own local offices, assistant chiefs and health facilities, so its systems are a ministry's field offices; counties appear as places, and the one mention of municipalities is the 1928 law. Nothing on county governments' own offices.
